validate.message: The plan must name at least one cohort.

Cohort ids must be unique idents, and each depends_on must name other cohorts without repeats or a cycle.

let.pr_state_current: published(pr) and published(pr_state) and latest(pr_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url

integration.done_when: approved(pr) and (approved(manual_merge_target) or (observed_state_current and (latest(observed_state).state == "merged" or (input.final_merge_policy == "allow_close_without_merge" and latest(observed_state).state == "closed_unmerged"))))
